claims.summary: All adapter promotion lanes bind one stable exact package identity that excludes mutable promotion attestations, removing the circular manifest/evidence hash while retaining the exact adapter contract.
Factual adapter promotion requires an exact preregistered four-run browser campaign whose raw option text and indexes are independently reconstructed and rescored on the frozen packet.

Production adapter promotion requires three recent live-browser runs whose ZIP, package manifest, trace, log, native runtime receipt, visual QA, app identity, and quality metrics agree semantically and byte-for-byte.
The promotion runner semantically verifies factual, single-model-judge, browser-device, and production evidence and exposes semantic issues instead of accepting hash-bound labels.
The release is an evaluator and identity correction only; it records no new adapter, model, factual, held-out, paid-reference, device-matrix, classroom, or human-validation result.
